title: When K-pop Meets Digital Fashion: Unveiling the Behind-the-Scenes Story of aespa's Whiplash!
description:
The behind-the-scenes creation story of the styling for the recently popular K-pop group aespa's new song "Whiplash" has been revealed!  
It was jointly created by 3D artists Park Jin Beom and Jon Sanchez using CLO and @MD official! When two exceptionally talented designers coincidentally came together to explore the futuristic tech-style fashion field, the beloved Whiplash Universe concept design was born!
transcript:
Hello, I'm Park Jin-beom, working on visual creative projects under the name TAGIREN.  
Recently, I worked on the girl group aespa's *We Flash* album i-aespa character artwork.  

Hi, I'm Yon Sanchez, a digital fashion creator and 3D artist.  
My work focuses on creating realistic and visually appealing clothing.  
I collaborated with Jin-beom on the *We Flash Universe* project.  

Two years ago, while preparing for an online lecture,  
I wanted to explain to the students how to make clothes and how to use existing clothing assets.  
At that time, I was looking for assets to use.  
Yon had many professionally and systematically produced clothes,  
so based on Yon’s clothes,  
I wanted to explain how to customize them to the students.  
That’s when I got in touch with Yon.  
I think that’s when we became friends.  

I looked at Jin-beom’s Instagram and thought,  
“Okay, this person knows what she’s doing.  
I love her style.  
I want to work with her.”  

The i-aespa character artwork was uploaded to my SNS by SM Entertainment.  
I saw the previous character artwork and, thankfully, he contacted me about the artwork.  
I think it was really good at the time.  
I always pursued a style that gave me a good opportunity to redesign the i-aespa character  
and design new clothes, so I had a lot of fun working on it.  
I think it was a meaningful project.  

At that time, I was in contact with Yon, and I knew Yon’s excellent skills,  
so I asked him to work with me on the i-aespa costume production project.  
Jin-beom sent me a direct message asking about this collaboration,  
and without much thought, I said,  
“Let’s go ahead with this.”  
We connected very quickly. It was very natural.  
It couldn’t have gone better than this.  

Collaborating together has been very smooth.  
We actively share connections, give each other mutual feedback, and help each other a lot.  
The project had a clear direction from the beginning.  
The process was very fluid.  
I quickly made the basic structure and then added the details.  

Yon and I had worked on a collaboration several times before,  
and thanks to this project, we were able to proceed quickly with smooth communication.  
Thanks to the collaboration between Clou and Marvelous Designer,  
I think we were able to work faster and more easily.  

Especially using Marvelous Designer,  
we had more time to work on concepts and levels of detail,  
so we were able to create high-quality artwork.  
We were also able to work more effectively and efficiently  
because we collaborated and communicated using Clou and Marvelous Designer.  
And since the files are compatible, it’s much easier to review them.  

I have been working with other K-pop artists since the i-aespa *We Flash Universe* project.  
I want to have a career in the game industry as well as fashion and entertainment,  
but my ultimate goal is to become a 3D artist in various industries, especially as a 3D character artist.  

I loved working on the i-aespa project.  
It opened many doors for me to different projects,  
with fashion brands, the automotive industry, and projects where you can always learn something new.  

As a dream, I would like to create my own fashion brand.  
But it’s a long-term dream, so I’m not in a hurry to do it.  
I need to keep learning, exploring, meeting people, and staying informed about trends.  

What is the most important part of your work?  
Clou is an essential part of my work.  
I would say it’s my daily life.  
Thanks to this, I can experiment digitally with different forms.  

I’m looking forward to showing you my new projects.  
Right now, I’m mainly working with Marvelous Designer,  
and I know that the compatibility between Clou and Marvelous Designer software  
is really good.  

Also, in order to achieve my goal,  
Marvelous Designer is a tool that should not be absent,  
so I plan to use it consistently throughout my career.  

What is your goal?  
To be continued in the next episode.

chunks.title: When K-pop Meets Digital Fashion: Unveiling the Behind-the-Scenes Story of aespa's Whiplash!
chunks.content: # When K-pop Meets Digital Fashion: Behind the Scenes of aespa's *Whiplash* This document details the collaboration and technical process behind the digital fashion artwork for aespa's *We Flash* album, focusing on the creative partnership, software tools (Clou and Marvelous Designer), and workflows used to design and produce high-quality 3D digital clothing and character art. --- ## Collaboration Between Visual Creatives: Park Jin-beom (TAGIREN) and Yon Sanchez This section covers the background and collaboration dynamics between Park Jin-beom (TAGIREN), a visual creative project lead, and Yon Sanchez, a digital fashion creator and 3D artist specializing in realistic clothing design. - Park Jin-beom is known for visual creative projects and worked on the character artwork for aespa’s *We Flash* album. - Yon Sanchez focuses on creating realistic and visually appealing 3D clothing and collaborated with Park Jin-beom on the *We Flash Universe* project. - Their collaboration began two years ago when Park wanted to teach students how to make and customize clothes using existing digital assets. Yon’s professionally produced clothing assets were ideal for this purpose. - Mutual respect for each other’s skills led to a natural and smooth working relationship once they started collaborating on the i-aespa costume project. - The collaboration was characterized by open communication, active feedback exchange, and shared connections, enabling an efficient workflow and clear creative direction. --- ## Technical Workflow and Software Tools: Clou and Marvelous Designer This section explains the technical tools and workflow used to create the digital fashion assets, highlighting the synergy between Clou and Marvelous Designer software. - The team used **Marvelous Designer**, a 3D garment design tool, to create realistic clothing with detailed fabric simulation. - **Clou** was used alongside Marvelous Designer for collaboration and file compatibility, improving review processes and communication. - The compatibility between Clou and Marvelous Designer enabled faster, more efficient work with more time dedicated to concept development and detailed refinement. - The workflow started with building the basic garment structure, followed by adding intricate details. - The combination of these tools allowed high-quality artwork creation, enhancing both the creative and technical aspects of the project. - File compatibility between Clou and Marvelous Designer was essential for seamless asset exchange and iteration. --- ## Professional Development and Industry Aspirations This section discusses Yon Sanchez’s career trajectory, goals, and reflections on working in digital fashion and 3D art within entertainment and beyond. - Since the aespa *We Flash Universe* project, Yon has worked with other K-pop artists and expanded into fashion brands and the automotive industry. - Their ultimate career goal is to become a versatile 3D character artist across multiple industries, including gaming, fashion, and entertainment. - Yon aspires to create a personal fashion brand but emphasizes continuous learning, networking, and staying updated on trends as priorities. - Marvelous Designer remains a critical tool for Yon’s career, with plans to use it consistently. - Clou is described as indispensable for daily digital experimentation with garment forms and design iterations.
